description: Minimal capability for the transient Dynamic Island window. Grants only what the island route needs: invoke for `get_island_state` (custom command, allowed by `core:default`) and listen for `island:show` (app-defined event, requires `core:event:allow-listen` explicitly — `core:default` does NOT include event listening for app events in Tauri 2). No filesystem, shell, notifications, or any other permissions — the island is content-only and should never touch the host system directly.
